jobs.label: 2 奶油卷毛犬
jobs.design: A soft cream curly-haired puppy, like a tiny cream puff. Entire coat in warm ivory and very pale biscuit beige, fluffy rounded face, two short floppy ears shaped as large soft rounded curls, three distinct small puff-like curls on top of forehead, a few simple scalloped curls along cheek outline. Symmetric face, no patches. Ivory muzzle subtly lighter than ears. Distinct rounded cloud silhouette, very simple stylized curls, not realistic wool. Sweet calm friendly expression.

jobs.label: 5 芝麻雪纳瑞
jobs.design: A cute sesame gray miniature schnauzer puppy. Soft warm desaturated gray coat, two small folded triangular ears, distinctive rounded cream-white eyebrows over both dark dot eyes and a short fluffy cream-white schnauzer beard/moustache around the muzzle. Beard is TWO rounded tufts and a softly scalloped short chin, not human whisker lines. Slightly squared rounded face with a cheeky but gentle closed smile. Dark warm brown tiny canine nose, gray forehead with no colored eye patch. Strong recognizable schnauzer features while retaining the reference's cute simple picture-book proportions.

jobs.label: 6 黑糖奶牛犬
jobs.design: A playful cream-and-dark-cocoa pinto puppy, not an actual cow. Soft milky cream-white face, two dark black-sugar cocoa-brown short floppy ears, one small asymmetrical dark cocoa patch at the upper VIEWER LEFT forehead reaching the ear root, eyes both on the cream area with no eye patch, cream muzzle and a tiny dark nose. A small cream forelock interrupts the upper forehead patch. Rounded slightly broad face, clean minimal patch shapes, sweet gentle closed smile, subtle peach cheeks. Cocoa areas should be deep warm brown, not harsh jet black. Clearly a different dog character from the reference and from a curly poodle.
